title: Resource Schema
description: Schema for resources data, including various types of links stored in a dictionary.

dimension.description: The main category or dimension of the resource.

theme.description: The specific theme within the dimension.

type.description: The type of resource (e.g., Señalética, TDR, Registro, Guía, Curso, Estándar).

standard_code.description: Unique identifier(s) for the resource. Can be a single code or a comma-separated list of codes.

urls.description: A dictionary containing various URLs related to the resource, with keys indicating the type of URL (e.g., 'web', 'curso', 'pdf', 'word', 'excel').

resource_code.description: A unique numerical identifier for the resource.
